name: Reachnet
summary: Satellite broadband + voice ISP of ORION SATELLITE SYSTEMS PTY LIMITED (ACN 103 918 832, ~2006); no longer live (domain now a parking proxy).

events.details: No longer live. Reachnet's retail ISP brand died in the rebrand to IPSTAR Broadband between Oct 2022 and Feb 2023, not 2015 (current) or 2024 (proposal).

refs.label: Last full Reachnet retail homepage, 25 Oct 2022.
By 23 Feb 2023 the retail brand had been replaced by a rebrand notice (the same notice in the proposal's May 2024 capture - it was never a 'live' retail page).
ABR business names for IPSTAR Australia Pty Ltd: IPSTAR Broadband name registered 25 May 2023; Reachnet name lingered on as a trading name only.
ABR: ORION SATELLITE SYSTEMS PTY LIMITED ACN 103 918 832
